name: pack-saas-api
description: Heuristics pack for SaaS backend APIs. Covers auth, rate limiting, multi-tenancy, billing safety, and API design.

lessons.pattern: Public endpoint deployed without rate limiting
lessons.preventive_rule: Every new public endpoint must have rate limiting in acceptance criteria (auth: 5-10 req/min/IP, read: 100 req/min/user, write: 20 req/min/user)

lessons.pattern: User data leak through error messages
lessons.preventive_rule: Error responses must never include: user emails, internal IDs, stack traces, SQL errors, or server paths

lessons.pattern: N+1 query on list endpoints causing latency spikes
lessons.preventive_rule: Every list endpoint must use eager loading or batch queries. Test with 100+ records.

lessons.pattern: Missing tenant isolation in multi-tenant queries
lessons.preventive_rule: Every database query must include tenant_id filter. No cross-tenant data access.

planning_rules.rule: Acceptance criteria must include: rate limit specification, input validation, auth requirement, response pagination (if list)
Require idempotency key, reconciliation log, and test for double-charge prevention
Plan must address: tenant isolation, PII filtering in logs, GDPR data access/deletion
Plan must include: signature verification, replay protection, idempotent processing

review_checks.check: All database queries include tenant_id filter — no cross-tenant data leaks
Payment operations use idempotency keys and log reconciliation events
List endpoints return paginated results with default and max page size
Error responses use consistent format: {error: {code, message, details}}
